items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: first band I called myself playing with was, uh, uh, Amos Riley.

ctx.x: When you, when you came down here, what was the first band you played with? You mentioned Jack Carey and, uh, Dooson, but was the first?
Well, uh, first band I called myself playing with was, uh, uh, Amos Riley. Oh, Amos Riley. Yeah.
Who else was in the band? Joe Howard. Joe Howard, yeah.
